name: Dual Nodes Generation with Connectivity Inversion
definition: Generation of surface nodes inside octree cells using Dual Marching Cubes (DMC) LUT, with a modification to handle ambiguous faces that cause non-manifold edges. It uses graph connectivity of cell vertices to determine dual node placement.
summary: Dual Nodes Generation with Connectivity Inversion resolves non-manifold edges in Manifold Dual Marching Cubes by generating two dual nodes for ambiguous faces, using exterior vertex connectivity to recover topological tunnels.
